title.vi: Lệnh Báo chí và nhà in (Miễn trừ) (Số 2) 2006
title.th: คำสั่งหนังสือพิมพ์และโรงพิมพ์ (การยกเว้น) (ฉบับที่ 2) 2006

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Newspaper and Printing Presses (Exemption) (No. 2) Order 2006 and shall come into operation on 1st April 2006.

2.—(1) Publications by government, government-aided and independent schools in Singapore and the corporations specified in the Schedule shall be exempted from section 21 of the Act.
(2) The Registrar may, at any time, by written notice to any school or corporation revoke an exemption of any publication referred to in sub-paragraph (1).
3. The Newspaper and Printing Presses (Exemption) (Schools Publications) Notification (N 3) is cancelled.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Corporations
1. Nanyang Technological University
2. National University of Singapore
3. Singapore Management University.
